films.title: Clashing Through the Snow
films.studio: Amazon MGM Studios / Wonderland Sound and Vision
films.extract: Clashing Through the Snow is an upcoming American Christmas comedy film directed by Carlson Young and written by Daniel Mackey and Rebecca Ewing. It stars Christopher Briney, Michelle Randolph, Lukas Gage, Paris Hilton, Julia Fox, and PJ Byrne.

films.title: Focker-in-Law
films.studio: Universal Pictures / Paramount Pictures / Tribeca Enterprises / Red Hour Productions
films.extract: Focker-in-Law is a 2026 American comedy film written and directed by John Hamburg from a story by Hamburg, Ilana Glazer, and Austen Earl. It is the fourth installment in the Fockers film series and the sequel to Little Fockers (2010).

films.title: Hexed
films.studio: Walt Disney Pictures / Walt Disney Animation Studios
films.description: 2026 film by Fawn Veerasunthorn and Jason Hand
films.extract: Disney's Hexed, known simply as just Hexed, is a 2026 American animated supernatural fantasy film produced by Walt Disney Animation Studios. It was directed by Fawn Veerasunthorn and Jason Hand  and written by Jared Bush and Dana Ledoux Miller from a story by Josie Trinidad, and stars Hailee Steinfeld, Rashida Jones, Jodie Foster, Walton Goggins, Henry Winkler, Dan Stevens, Brett Gelman, Tracey Ullman, and Stephen Fry.

films.title: The Further Mis-Adventures of Cliff Booth
films.pageTitle: The Further Mis-Adventures of Cliff Booth
films.extract: The Further Mis-Adventures of Cliff Booth is a 2026 American crime dramedy film directed by David Fincher and written by Quentin Tarantino. Produced by Peter Mavromates, Ceán Chaffin and Brad Pitt, it is a stand-alone sequel and spin-off to Once Upon a Time in Hollywood (2019), with Pitt reprising his role as stunt double Cliff Booth.

films.title: Hershey
films.extract: Hershey is a 2026 American biographical drama film directed by Mark Waters and written by Sharon Paul and Timothy Michael Hayes.

films.title: The Man with the Bag
films.extract: The Man with the Bag is an upcoming American Christmas action comedy film directed by Adam Shankman and written by Allan Rice. It stars Arnold Schwarzenegger, Alan Ritchson, Awkwafina, Liza Koshy, Kyle Mooney, Adrian Martinez, Jane Krakowski, and Ken Jeong.

films.title: Behemoth!
films.extract: Behemoth! is a 2026 American comedy-drama film written and directed by Tony Gilroy.

films.title: Violent Night 2
films.extract: Violent Night 2 is an upcoming American Christmas action comedy film directed by Tommy Wirkola and written by Pat Casey and Josh Miller. It is a sequel to Violent Night (2022).

films.title: Ray Gunn
films.extract: Ray Gunn is a 2026 American animated mystery film directed by Brad Bird and written by Bird and Matthew Robbins. It stars Sam Rockwell as Ray Gunn, the last human private detective, in a retro-futuristic world inhabited by humans and aliens.

films.title: Above the Below
films.description: 2026 film by Idris Elba and Martin Owen
films.extract: Above the Below is an upcoming survival thriller film co-directed by Idris Elba and Martin Owen.  Elizabeth Morris, Matt Mitchell, and Vicki Sargent wrote the screenplay from a story by Owen.

films.title: The Debut
films.extract: The Debut is a 2026 American musical comedy-drama film written, co-produced and directed by Jesse Eisenberg. The film stars Julianne Moore as Mona Friedman, a New Jersey housewife who auditions for a part in a fictional musical run by a strong-willed and enigmatic director (Paul Giamatti).

films.title: Zero A. D.: The Birth of Christ
films.pageTitle: Zero A. D.: The Birth of Christ
films.extract: Zero A. D.: The Birth of Christ is an upcoming American epic biblical drama film set during the Massacre of the Innocents as told in the Gospel of Matthew from the Bible. Directed by Alejandro Gómez Monteverde, it stars Deva Cassel, Sam Worthington, Ben Mendelsohn, Gael García Bernal, and Jim Caviezel.

films.title: Avengers: Doomsday
films.extract: Avengers: Doomsday is an upcoming American superhero film based on the Marvel Comics superhero team the Avengers. Produced by Marvel Studios and distributed by Walt Disney Studios Motion Pictures, it is intended to be the sequel to Avengers: Endgame (2019) and the 39th film in the Marvel Cinematic Universe (MCU).

films.title: Dune: Part Three
films.extract: Dune: Part Three is an upcoming American epic space opera film directed by Denis Villeneuve, from a screenplay he wrote with Brian K. Vaughan. Based on the 1969 novel Dune Messiah by Frank Herbert, it is the sequel to Dune: Part Two (2024) and the final installment of a trilogy of films developed by Legendary Pictures.

films.title: The Angry Birds Movie 3
films.studio: Paramount Pictures / Prime Focus Studios / Rovio Entertainment / Sega / Dentsu
films.extract: The Angry Birds Movie 3 is an upcoming animated comedy film based on the Angry Birds video game series. It is the sequel to The Angry Birds Movie 2 (2019) and the third installment in the Angry Birds film series.

films.title: Jumanji: Open World
films.extract: Jumanji: Open World is an upcoming American action-adventure film co-produced and directed by Jake Kasdan, who co-wrote it with Jeff Pinkner and Scott Rosenberg. It is the fifth and final installment in the Jumanji film series and the sequel to Jumanji: The Next Level (2019).

films.title: Werwulf
films.studio: Focus Features / Working Title Films / Maiden Voyage Pictures
films.extract: Werwulf is an upcoming period gothic folk horror film directed by Robert Eggers, who co-wrote the script with Sjón. The film stars Aaron Taylor-Johnson, Willem Dafoe, and Lily-Rose Depp.

films.title: Artificial
films.studio: Neon / Heyday Films / Frenesy Film Company
films.extract: Artificial is a 2026 biographical comedy-drama film directed and co-produced by Luca Guadagnino and written by Simon Rich. The film stars Andrew Garfield and Yura Borisov as OpenAI CEO Sam Altman and co-founder Ilya Sutskever, respectively.

films.title: Mr. Irrelevant
films.extract: Mr. Irrelevant is an upcoming American biographical sports drama film about John Tuggle, who was drafted by the New York Giants as the final selection of the 1983 NFL draft.

films.title: River
films.studio: Universal Pictures / Blumhouse Atomic / Independent Film Company / Shudder / Spooky Pictures
films.extract: River is a 2026 American slasher film written and directed by Joshua Giuliano, in his directorial debut. The film stars Jane Levy, Jessica Rothe, Max Mattern, and Dane DiLiegro.

films.title: Children of Blood and Bone
films.description: Upcoming film directed by Gina Prince-Bythewood
films.extract: Children of Blood and Bone is an upcoming American fantasy film directed by Gina Prince-Bythewood, who co-wrote the screenplay with Tomi Adeyemi, based on the 2018 novel by Adeyemi. The film stars Thuso Mbedu, Damson Idris, Amandla Stenberg, Tosin Cole, Cynthia Erivo, Lashana Lynch, Zackary Momoh, Richard Mofe-Damijo, Chiwetel Ejiofor, Regina King, Idris Elba, and Viola Davis.

films.title: The Beekeeper 2
films.extract: The Beekeeper 2 is an upcoming action thriller film directed by Timo Tjahjanto and written by Kurt Wimmer and Zak Penn. It serves as the sequel to The Beekeeper (2024), with Jason Statham, Emmy Raver-Lampman, Bobby Naderi, Jemma Redgrave, and Jeremy Irons reprising their roles, and Yara Shahidi, Pom Klementieff and Adam Copeland joining.

films.title: The Take
films.extract: The Take is an upcoming American heist film directed by Fernando Meirelles and written by Simon Kinberg. The film stars Denzel Washington, Robert Pattinson, Daisy Edgar-Jones, Danai Gurira, Sean Harris, Moisés Arias, and Justin Kirk.

films.title: Animal Friends
films.studio: Warner Bros. Pictures / Legendary Pictures / Maximum Effort / Prime Focus Studios
films.extract: Animal Friends is an upcoming American live-action animated adventure comedy film directed by Peter Atencio. The film features the voices of Ryan Reynolds, Jason Momoa, and Lil Rel Howery, with Aubrey Plaza, Daniel Levy, Addison Rae, and Ellie Bamber in live-action roles.

films.title: Lords of War
films.extract: Lords of War is an upcoming crime drama film. Serving as a sequel to Lord of War (2005), the film was written and directed by Andrew Niccol, and stars co-producer Nicolas Cage, who reprises his role, along with Bill Skarsgård, Laura Harrier, Sylvia Hoeks, and Greg Tarzan Davis.

films.title: Slayground
films.extract: Slayground is an upcoming American action thriller film written, produced and directed by Jeremy Saulnier. It stars Cory Michael Smith, Chase Sui Wonders, Stanley Simons, Sophie Wilde, Young Mazino, Imogen Poots, Matty Matheson, James Badge Dale, and Stephen Root.

films.title: The Rescue
films.studio: Paramount Pictures / Spyglass Media Group / Hideout Pictures
films.extract: The Rescue is an upcoming American contemporary Western action thriller film directed by Potsy Ponciroli and written by John Fusco. The film stars Brandon Sklenar, Josh Lucas, Hassie Harrison, Lorelei Olivia Mote, Nick Searcy, Austin Amelio, Spencer Treat Clark, Tim Blake Nelson, and Josh Duhamel.

films.title: Remain
films.studio: Warner Bros. Pictures / Blinding Edge Pictures
films.extract: Remain is a 2026 American supernatural romantic thriller film written, directed, and produced by M. Night Shyamalan, based on an idea he developed with Nicholas Sparks, who separately wrote a version of the story as a novel published in 2025. The film stars Jake Gyllenhaal, Phoebe Dynevor, Ashley Walters, Julie Hagerty, and Jay O. Sanders.

films.title: Ice Age: Boiling Point
films.extract: Ice Age: Boiling Point is an upcoming American animated adventure comedy film directed by John C. Donkin. Produced by 20th Century Studios and Bardel Entertainment, it is the sixth main installment in the Ice Age film series following Ice Age: Collision Course (2016), and the seventh installment overall.

films.title: Karoshi
films.extract: Karōshi is an upcoming American dystopian science fiction action film written and directed by Takashi Doscher. It stars Teo Yoo, Isabel May, Takehiro Hira, Bill Camp, Show Kasamatsu, Giancarlo Esposito, and Cynthia Erivo.

films.title: The Comeback King
films.extract:
The Comeback King is an upcoming American comedy film directed by Judd Apatow and co-written by Apatow and Glen Powell, who stars in the main role alongside Cristin Milioti, Madelyn Cline, Stavros Halkias, Jin Hao Li, Vanessa Bayer, Tig Notaro, and Kumail Nanjiani.
The Comeback King is scheduled to be released in the United States on February 5, 2027, by Universal Pictures.

films.title: Narnia: The Magician's Nephew
films.extract: Narnia: The Magician's Nephew is an upcoming epic high fantasy film written for the screen, directed, and co-produced by Greta Gerwig, based on the 1955 novel The Magician's Nephew, the sixth published and first chronological novel in the children's book series The Chronicles of Narnia by C. S. Lewis. It will be the fourth film adaptation based on the The Chronicles of Narnia series of novels, following a trilogy of films produced by Walden Media.

films.title: CoComelon: The Movie
films.studio: Universal Pictures / DreamWorks Animation / Moonbug Entertainment / Prime Focus Studios
films.extract: CoComelon: The Movie is an upcoming animated musical adventure comedy film loosely based on the YouTube series CoComelon created by Moonbug Entertainment. The film is produced by DreamWorks Animation, Moonbug, Flywheel Media, and Prime Focus Studios.

films.title: Gatto
films.studio: Walt Disney Pictures / Pixar Animation Studios
films.extract: Gatto is an upcoming American animated comedy film produced by Pixar Animation Studios for Walt Disney Pictures. Directed by Enrico Casarosa, and written by Casarosa, Tripper Clancy and Andy Siara, it stars Mark Ruffalo, Laurence Fishburne, Casarosa, Bianca Babaşa, Sherry Cola, John Turturro, Rumen Sali Shopov, Rhys Darby, and Isabella Rosellini.

films.title: The Thomas Crown Affair
films.description: Upcoming film by Michael B. Jordan
films.extract: The Thomas Crown Affair is an upcoming American romantic heist action film directed by Michael B. Jordan and written by Drew Pearce and Jason Hall, with Leslie Dixon and Kurt Wimmer also receiving screenwriting credit. It is a second remake of the 1968 film, following its 1999 remake with Pierce Brosnan.

films.title: The Exorcist: Martyrs
films.studio: Universal Pictures / Blumhouse Atomic / Morgan Creek Entertainment
films.extract: The Exorcist: Martyrs is an upcoming American supernatural horror film written and directed by Mike Flanagan. It is the seventh installment in The Exorcist franchise.

films.title: Sonic the Hedgehog 4
films.studio: Paramount Pictures / Sega Sammy Group / Original Film
films.extract: Sonic the Hedgehog 4 is an upcoming American action-adventure comedy film based on the Sonic the Hedgehog video game series. The fourth in the Sonic film series, it was directed by Jeff Fowler.

films.title: The Nightingale
films.studio: TriStar Pictures / Lewellen Pictures / Hello Sunshine
films.extract: The Nightingale is an upcoming American historical drama film directed by Michael Morris and written by Dana Stevens and Ann Peacock, based on the 2015 novel by Kristin Hannah. It stars sisters Elle and Dakota Fanning in the lead roles, with Edmund Donovan, Albrecht Schuch, Shira Haas, and Mark Rylance in supporting roles.

films.title: Godzilla x Kong: Supernova
films.extract: Godzilla x Kong: Supernova is an upcoming American monster film directed by Grant Sputore. Produced by Legendary Pictures and distributed by Warner Bros.

films.title: Day Drinker
films.studio: Lionsgate / Thunder Road Films / Infinitum Nihil
films.extract: Day Drinker is an upcoming American supernatural revenge thriller film directed by Marc Webb and written by Zach Dean. It stars Johnny Depp, Madelyn Cline, and Penélope Cruz.

films.title: Not Alone
films.director: Eric Guillon, Claire Dodgson, Jonathan Del Val
films.extract: Not Alone is an upcoming American animated science fiction romantic comedy film directed by Eric Guillon, Claire Dodgson (in her directorial debut), and Jonathan del Val. Produced by Universal Pictures and Illumination, the film will star the voices of Timothée Chalamet and Selena Gomez as two clueless romantics making the world's very first-ever plant-powered rocket, only to encounter three tiny aliens stranded on Earth who seek a way back home while evading an intergalactic officer.

films.title: Spaceballs: The New One
films.description: Upcoming parody film by Josh Greenbaum
films.extract: Spaceballs: The New One is an upcoming American space opera comedy film directed by Josh Greenbaum and written by Josh Gad, Dan Hernandez and Benji Samit. It serves as the sequel to Spaceballs (1987).

films.title: The Legend of Zelda
films.studio: Columbia Pictures / Nintendo / Arad Productions / OddBall Entertainment
films.extract: The Legend of Zelda is an upcoming fantasy adventure film based on the video game series of the same name by Nintendo. It is directed by Wes Ball, written by T. S. Nowlin, and produced by Columbia Pictures, Nintendo, and OddBall Entertainment.

films.title: The Resurrection of the Christ: Part One
films.pageTitle: The Resurrection of the Christ: Part One
films.extract: The Resurrection of the Christ: Part One is an upcoming American epic biblical drama film directed by Mel Gibson from a script he co-wrote with Randall Wallace, and based on the story he wrote with his brother Chris Gibson and Wallace. Gibson also serves as producer alongside Bruce Davey.

films.title: Anything but Ghosts
films.studio: Focus Features / Blumhouse Atomic / Spooky Pictures / Divide/Conquer
films.extract: Anything but Ghosts is an upcoming American comedy horror film directed by Curry Barker who co-wrote the script with Cooper Tomlinson. The film stars Tomlinson, Barker, Violet McGraw, Chris Reinacher, Bryce Dallas Howard, Aaron Paul, and Matthew Lillard.

films.title: F.A.S.T.
films.extract: F.A.S.T. is an upcoming action thriller film directed by Ben Richardson and written by Taylor Sheridan. It stars Brandon Sklenar, Juliana Canfield, LaKeith Stanfield, Jason Clarke, Sam Claflin, and Trevante Rhodes.

films.title: The Catch
films.studio: Universal Pictures / 21 Laps Entertainment / Fruit Tree
films.extract: The Catch is an upcoming American romantic comedy film directed by Dave McCary and written by Patrick Kang and Michael Levin. It stars Emma Stone, Chris Pine, Ashley Padilla, Druski, Tim Robbins, and Sissy Spacek.

films.title: Star Wars: Starfighter
films.description: Upcoming film directed by Shawn Levy
films.extract: Star Wars: Starfighter is an upcoming American space opera film directed by Shawn Levy and written by Jonathan Tropper. Produced by Lucasfilm and 21 Laps Entertainment, and set to be distributed by Walt Disney Studios Motion Pictures, it is intended to be an installment in the Star Wars franchise and set five years after the events of the film Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker (2019).

films.title: John Rambo
films.extract: John Rambo is an upcoming American war action film directed by Jalmari Helander and written by Rory Haines and Sohrab Noshirvani. It is a prequel to First Blood (1982) and the sixth installment in the Rambo film series, telling the origin story of John Rambo, portrayed by Noah Centineo.

films.title: Possession
films.extract: Possession is an upcoming American psychological horror film written, produced and directed by Parker Finn that serves as a remake of the 1981 film by Andrzej Żuławski. It stars Margaret Qualley, Callum Turner, Diego Calva, and Paul Dano.

films.title: How to Train Your Dragon 2
films.pageTitle: How to Train Your Dragon 2 (2027 film)
films.studio: Universal Pictures / DreamWorks Animation / Marc Platt Productions
films.extract: How to Train Your Dragon 2 is an upcoming American fantasy film and a live-action remake of the 2014 animated film by DreamWorks Animation, itself loosely based on Cressida Cowell's book series. It will be the second installment of the live-action How to Train Your Dragon film series following How to Train Your Dragon (2025), and the fifth film overall in the franchise.

films.title: Spider-Man: Beyond the Spider-Verse
films.studio: Columbia Pictures / Sony Pictures Animation / Marvel Entertainment / Pascal Pictures / Lord Miller Productions / Arad Productions
films.extract: Spider-Man: Beyond the Spider-Verse is an upcoming American animated superhero film based on the Marvel Comics character Miles Morales / Spider-Man. Produced by Columbia Pictures and Sony Pictures Animation, it is the direct sequel to Spider-Man: Across the Spider-Verse (2023) and the final installment in the Spider-Verse trilogy.

films.title: Untitled Ocean's Eleven prequel
films.studio: Warner Bros. Pictures / Alcon Entertainment / LuckyChap Entertainment / Everyman Pictures
films.extract:
The untitled Ocean's Eleven prequel is an upcoming American heist comedy film written and directed by Bradley Cooper, who will star alongside Margot Robbie, Wagner Moura, and Monica Barbaro.
The film will be released in theaters on June 25, 2027, by Warner Bros.

films.title: Shrek 5
films.extract: Shrek 5 is an upcoming American animated fantasy comedy film loosely based on the 1990 children's picture book Shrek! by William Steig.

films.title: Man of Tomorrow
films.studio: Warner Bros. Pictures / DC Studios / Troll Court Entertainment / The Safran Company
films.description: Upcoming DC Studios film by James Gunn
films.extract: Man of Tomorrow is an upcoming American superhero film featuring the DC Comics characters Superman and Lex Luthor. Written and directed by James Gunn, it will be the fourth film in the DC Universe (DCU) and a follow-up to Superman (2025).

films.title: A Minecraft Movie Squared
films.studio: Warner Bros. Pictures / Legendary Pictures / Vertigo Entertainment / Mojang Studios
films.extract: A Minecraft Movie Squared is an upcoming adventure comedy film based on the 2011 video game Minecraft by Mojang Studios. The sequel to A Minecraft Movie (2025), it is directed by Jared Hess from a screenplay he co-wrote with Chris Galletta.

films.title: A Quiet Place Part III
films.studio: Paramount Pictures / Platinum Dunes / Sunday Night Productions
films.description: Upcoming American horror film by John Krasinski
films.extract: A Quiet Place Part III is an upcoming American post-apocalyptic horror film written and directed by John Krasinski. The fourth installment in the A Quiet Place film series, the film is the sequel to A Quiet Place Part II (2020), serving as the third and final film in a trilogy that began with A Quiet Place (2018).

films.title: The New Simpsons Movie
films.studio: 20th Century Studios / 20th Century Animation / Gracie Films
films.extract: The New Simpsons Movie is an upcoming American animated comedy film based on the Fox animated sitcom The Simpsons created by Matt Groening. Directed by Rob Oliver in his feature-length directorial debut and produced by 20th Century Studios and Gracie Films, it is the second feature film adaptation of the series and the sequel to The Simpsons Movie (2007).

films.title: The Great Beyond
films.extract: The Great Beyond is an upcoming American science fantasy film written, co-produced, and directed by J. J. Abrams. The film stars Glen Powell, Jenna Ortega, Emma Mackey, Sophie Okonedo, Merritt Wever, and Samuel L. Jackson.

films.title: The Mummy: Book of the Dead
films.pageTitle: The Mummy: Book of the Dead
films.studio: Universal Pictures / Radio Silence Productions / Project X Entertainment
films.extract: The Mummy: Book of the Dead is an upcoming American action adventure film directed by Matt Bettinelli-Olpin and Tyler Gillett, and written by David Coggeshall. It is a direct sequel to The Mummy (1999) and The Mummy Returns (2001), ignoring the events of The Mummy: Tomb of the Dragon Emperor (2008), and is the fourth installment in Stephen Sommers’ The Mummy series.
